description: This source file defines the 'TextArea' class within the MigraDoc library, specifically for representing an area object in charts that contains text or legend. It includes properties and methods for manipulation, serialization, cloning, and containing elements like paragraphs, tables, images, and legends.

classes.name: TextArea
classes.description: Represents a chart area that contains text or legend components within a chart object.

classes.name: TextArea.TextAreaValues
classes.description: Holds internal nullable properties for the TextArea, such as size, style, formatting, padding, alignment, and contained elements.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the TextArea instance.

methods.name: AddParagraph
methods.description: Adds a new paragraph to the TextArea.

methods.name: AddParagraph
methods.description: Adds a new paragraph with specified text to the TextArea.

methods.name: AddTable
methods.description: Adds a new table to the TextArea.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Adds a new image to the TextArea.

methods.name: AddLegend
methods.description: Adds a new legend to the TextArea.
